Text: Performance evaluation report: The team tested 10 local models across 50 benchmark cases. Model A achieved 94% pass rate with 120ms latency. Model B achieved 82% pass rate with 45ms latency. Although Model B was 2.5x faster, Model A had zero hallucination on critical schema constraints. The recommendation is to use Model A for verification tasks and Model B for draft generation.
